title: Book an appointment at a service centre
summary: Book an appointment online to visit a service centre and complete transactions that require an in-person visit.
intro:
Some transactions require you to visit a service centre to complete them.

If you'd like to avoid wait times or delays at the service centre, book an appointment online.
what_you_need: Check what you need to bring to your appointment and make sure you've completed any paperwork that's required before you arrive at the service centre.

how_to_steps.text: Select your appointment type from the drop-down menu.
Select the most convenient service centre.
Choose a date and time for your appointment.
